subject: general
question: What is the name of the cell created in 2016 by the Government of India in which a dedicated team has been established to promote Korean investment in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Korea Plus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Korea Plus was established in June 2016 as a special initiative between the Indian Ministry of Commerce and Industry and the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (**KOTRA**).
 
• Its primary objective is to facilitate and attract Korean investments into India by providing a range of comprehensive services to Korean firms and investors.
 
• The initiative aims to strengthen the economic partnership between India and South Korea.
 
• Korea Plus offers a single-window facilitation service, focusing on assisting Korean companies in expediting their investment plans in India.
 
• This includes providing necessary information, coordinating with various government departments, and helping navigate regulatory and policy landscapes. By addressing potential bottlenecks and offering support through every stage of the investment process, Korea Plus helps enhance the ease of doing business for Korean companies in India.
 
• The dedicated team consists of representatives from both the South Korean government and Indian ministries, ensuring seamless bilateral cooperation. Since its establishment, Korea Plus has been instrumental in attracting high-profile Korean investments in sectors such as electronics, chemicals, textiles, food processing, and automobiles. Notable examples include investments by companies like Samsung, Hyundai, and LG Electronics, which have expanded their operations in India.
 
• Korea Plus serves as a vital link fostering closer economic ties between the two countries, reflecting the broader strategic partnership that encompasses trade, investment, and technological collaboration.
